{"code": "import pandas as pd

data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate by patient_id, keeping the row with the highest sample_seq
# This ensures one row per patient
data_dedup = data.loc[data.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Filter for treatment arm
treatment_arm = data_dedup[data_dedup['arm'] == 'treatment']

# Compute response rate: fraction who responded (responded == 1)
response_rate = treatment_arm['responded'].mean()

# Print the raw value to ensure it's captured
print(response_rate)"}
